clips.title: The story
paras: In Alterac Valley, Horde initiates seek the Frostwolf Banner in Wildpaw Cavern. Recovering it is an ancestral rite of passage that awakens their battle spirit and earns their first clan insignia.

Horde warriors seeking a place among the Frostwolf clan face a trial of grit in Alterac Valley. Warmaster Laggrond sends new recruits south into Wildpaw Cavern, where territorial gnolls fill the damp, hostile corridors. Reaching the hidden banner and bringing it back unbroken proves their courage and shows their battle rage has awakened. The trial earns each warrior the Frostwolf initiate's insignia.
